Initial Setup

Setup of the HP Googlebook was intuitive and pretty quick.
This "Googlebook" by HP is a new brand of OS and Laptop for Google.
Nearly every app available on Android is available here, and users can even cast apps directly from their phone to the laptop.

Display

The 120hz 14‑inch 3K OLED touchscreen is a marvel of modern science.
Could use some polishing when it comes to running applications in full screen mode.
The 3K OLED display is another standout feature.

Initial Setup

Setup of the HP Googlebook was intuitive and pretty quick.
We all know that Android apps seem to lag behind iOS, iPad OS and MacOS.
Performance, however, is not one of those concerns.

Design

The HP Googlebook is a stunning case study in beautifully simple design.
The laptop is very sleek, it has a nice and grippy soft matte texture throughout the hardware and the keyboard.
The foundation is solid, but small usability issues occasionally get in the way.

Battery Life

HP rates the battery life at 19 hours, and in my usage I got just under that in mixed usage.
If you need to charge it while using it, you will be down to a single USB C port to use.
Battery life is also great on this as well.
